rss: Overcooked? Why robotic pizza makers are failing
title: Robot Pizza Makers Face Challenges
story: Pizza-Bots were supposed to make pizzas super fast, but some are breaking down. This means people have to make pizzas the old way.
storyBig: The initial promise of robot pizza makers revolutionizing the Pizza industry has hit a snag. Technical failures have impacted PZZA, causing a reevaluation of their reliance on robotics.
think: Why do machines sometimes break down?
bull: Robots can make lots of pizzas when they work!
bear: Robots breaking means delays in pizza making.

rss: Plug-in solar panels are coming to a shop near you - here's what to know
title: Plug-In Solar Panels Shine Bright
story: New easy solar panels can help homes save on bills. They plug in like a toy to power homes using sunshine.
storyBig: The introduction of plug-in solar panels is expected to transform energy consumption for homes. SOLR may benefit from increased adoption as these panels help reduce energy costs significantly.
think: How do solar panels use the sun to make energy?
bull: Solar panels help save money on electricity.
bear: Some homes may not have space for panels.
